replay_fidelity.prompt: byte-identical to the logged prompt (round-trip asserted per row)
replay_fidelity.system: rebuilt from today's identity.md via configure_prompting; identity.md is mutable, so a row logged before the last identity distillation ran under a different system prompt than this replay uses
replay_fidelity.sink: llm.configure is never called — no telemetry or audit sink is wired

collapse_rules.topk: k = the same row's A/free/rep1 selection size
collapse_rules.note: reported for scoring arms (C, D) only; set arms have one set
